notes: Zoom in on the fighting and you hear it: small-arms and machine-gun fire from units in contact, explosions, IEDs and ambushes, incoming artillery, missiles, rockets and jet strikes, plus the rumble of moving vehicles and the beat of helicopter rotors. The closer you zoom and the nearer the action is to the centre of the screen, the louder it gets; it works in the 3D view and for multiplayer partners too
Settings › Map: Sound on or off and a volume level
